item.itunes:title: 最強免費音訊軟體 Audacity 4.0 大改版：老牌免費神器徹底重生，現在好用到不像免費的！
item.itunes:author: PAPAYA 電腦教室
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FckfSD6Y3Zs

值得閱讀的理由

  • 快速了解 Audacity 4.0 全新現代化深色介面與錄音前置設定技巧。
  • 學會處理多軌 Podcast 錄音常見的冷氣低頻雜音與雙麥克風串音問題。
  • 掌握音訊非破壞性剪輯、多軌同步、壓縮器平衡音量及等化器人聲修飾等實用音訊後製技巧。

摘要

全新介面與專案基礎設定

作者以經營「街角書店」的主角「阿雲」為例，示範如何使用最新發布的免費音訊編輯工具 Audacity 4.0 來製作 Podcast 節目。阿雲完成軟體安裝後，建立了全新專案並切換至舒適的現代化深色主題（Dark）。作者說明，開始錄音前僅需確認播放裝置與錄音裝置兩項關鍵設定，搭配空白鍵播放與循環播放（Loop Playback）功能，即可輕鬆反覆聆聽與確認錄製的聲音片段。

多軌音訊匯入與雜音清除法

阿雲將書店對談的原音檔案匯入時間軸，並調整軌道名稱與波形高度以利視覺化操作。在對話中，作者發現背景伴隨著持續的冷氣低頻雜音，因此示範選取雜音片段進行降噪（Noise Reduction）採樣與套用。此外，針對來賓麥克風收到阿雲聲音的串音（Crosstalk）現象，阿雲藉由噪聲門（Noise Gate）指令迅速消除閾值以下的微弱人聲干擾，並搭配靜音（Silence）功能將殘留的頑固噪點徹底歸零。

精準剪輯與多軌同步維護

錄音過程中難免會有吃螺絲或清喉嚨等多餘片段，作者展示了直接拖曳邊緣的非破壞性編輯，以及運用美工刀工具（Razor Tool）或快速鍵切割音軌的技巧。為了防止剪去失誤段落後導致雙方問答節奏脫節，阿雲將兩軌片段進行群組（Group）綁定，確保對話能同步移動；同時解說了保留間隙、單軌遞補與全軌遞補三種刪除模式的差異，最後再以合併（Merge）功能將剪輯後的零碎片段無縫縫合。

動態音量平衡與等化器人聲優化

訪談時來賓情緒起伏常導致音量忽大忽小，阿雲套用壓縮器（Compressor）壓縮動態範圍，拉近大聲與小聲之間的差距，並利用增益（Gain）適度提升整體音量，使雙方音軌波形達到均衡。最後，面對聲音偏悶且不夠透亮的問題，作者指引阿雲開啟參數等化器（Parametric Equalizer），將 100 Hz 以下無用的低頻雜音直接濾除，讓 Podcast 訪談人聲呈現如同專業錄音室般的清晰質感。

================================================

# Audacity 4.0 簡介

Hi, everyone. Today I want to talk to you about. It is a well-known and free audio editing tool, and recently, the latest version 4.0 was released, featuring significant updates and improvements to the entire interface and its functions. Alright, let's assume our story's protagonist is A-Yun, who runs a small independent bookstore called Corner Bookstore. Every week, A-Yun gathers with guests to talk about books, and he wants to record these conversations to create a podcast called Corner Book Club. To edit the recorded content, A-Yun goes. to the Audacity homepage to download the software. Since A-Yun doesn't want to register for another platform account, he chooses the download link below. After the download is finished, A-Yun double-clicks the installer file to easily complete the Audacity installation. Okay, after opening Audacity, we can click the plus sign on the screen to create a brand-new project. Version 4.0 provides a more modern dark interface. If you would like to try it out, you can switch to the Appearance tab. Then, select "Dark," and the entire interface will transform into a more comfortable dark theme. To record audio in Audacity, we only need two settings. One is the Playback Device, which determines which device the audio will play from. And the Recording Device, which determines which microphone or device will be used for audio input. Once set up, we just click the record button in the upper left corner to start speaking into the microphone. After you are done recording, just press the stop.

# 設定裝置並錄音

button next to it. If you want to listen to the recorded clip, you can press the spacebar on your keyboard to start playback. Or, if you want to repeatedly check a specific short segment, you can enable the Loop Playback feature in the upper left corner. This allows you to select the range you want to listen to; once it plays to the end of this area, it will automatically return to the start to repeat that segment. Finally, if you no longer need this test audio track, you can simply open the right-click menu and remove it. Alright, A-Yun plans to import the two. original files recorded at the bookstore into Audacity for editing. There are two ways to import files. One is to go to the File menu and select "Import," then choose the audio file from your folder; the second way is to drag the file directly from the folder into the timeline at the zero-second mark. To make identification easier, we can double-click the track title here to change the track name to the guest's name. Next, use your mouse to drag the track dividers to increase the height of both audio tracks so the waveforms are. clearer while editing. Alright, let's listen to a short section. Today is our first episode, and I've invited our shop's most frequent guest, Teacher Chen . >> Hi everyone, I'm Lao Chen. Okay, if we hold down the Alt key and use the mouse to zoom in, you'll notice a persistent low-frequency background noise in the recording, as well as the sound of the AC running. To remove this noise, you can select a segment that contains the AC sound. Go to the Effects menu at the top, run.

# 移除背景噪音

the Noise Reduction command, and click the button on the left so it can learn the noise profile. Once the sample is captured, we can select the entire clip. Return to the Effects menu and open the same Noise Reduction dialog box. Here, you can specify the noise reduction level; for instance, I'll set it to 12 decibels. Click Apply. Now those small, irregular waveforms will instantly disappear. We can repeat this step for guest Lao Chen's track as well, making the vocals in the recording clearer and more. natural. Alright, you'll notice that although the AC noise is gone, there are still some waveforms in Lao Chen's track that look like noise. If you want to listen to this section in isolation, you can click the "Solo" button next to it to play only this audio track. Alternatively, you can temporarily mute Ah Yun's track to achieve the same result. Alright, let's have a listen. Hello everyone, welcome to the show, wait, I messed that up, let's start over. >> Okay, you'll find that this noise isn't from the AC, but a phenomenon called.

# 使用噪音閘門處理串音

crosstalk—meaning when Ah Yun is speaking, Lao Chen's microphone is slightly picking up Ah Yun's voice. To solve this, we can select Lao Chen's clip and then go to the Effects menu to run a command called "Noise Gate." This command allows you to quickly remove faint noise below a certain volume level; for example, I'll set it to -30 decibels. Click Apply, and the waveform underneath will turn into almost a clean, straight line. If there are still a few louder noise artifacts remaining on screen that weren't cleared . You can just execute "Silence" from. the Edit menu to completely wipe out that section of noise. Okay, at the beginning of the recording, Ah Yun accidentally flubbed his lines, so let's take a listen. >> Hello everyone, welcome to the show, eh , wait, I messed that up, let's start over. Okay, so there are several ways to cut out this outtake. First, you can directly drag the edge of the audio clip to trim off the part where the mistake was made. This operation is a non-destructive edit , meaning if you change your mind later , you can always drag the edge back, and the original audio will reappear.

# 修剪音訊片段

The second method is to go to the top and enable the Razor Tool. This tool allows you to quickly cut audio clips with a mouse click. If you hold down the Shift key, you can cut multiple audio tracks at once. After cutting, we can select the clip where A-Yun made a mistake. Press the Delete key on your keyboard. The first time you delete, it will ask if you want to keep the gap. For now, we can leave the default setting as is. This will leave a blank space at the beginning of A-Yun's and Lao-Ying's tracks. However, be very. careful here. If we drag A-Yun's clip forward, the Q& A timing between the two will become disorganized and out of sync. Therefore, we must hold down the Ctrl or Command key to select both people's dialogue at the same time. If needed, you can also use the right-click menu to group the two clips together. This way, we can move both people's conversation at once without timing sync issues. Okay, there is another part in the middle of the interview that needs to be handled. Let's listen. >> Riding that old bike feels like riding.

back to your father's generation. Would you like to have some water first ? >> Okay, thank you. Alright, let's continue . >> Okay, I'll cut that part out. >> So, here we need to trim out Lao-Chen's throat-clearing sound. In addition to using the Razor Tool, you can also use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl or Cmd + K to cut before and after the throat-clearing clip. After isolating this segment, since the current conversation is grouped, we must first ungroup it from the right-click menu to handle this middle segment. individually. There are actually three different ways to delete clips in Audacity. If you only press the Delete key, the deleted position will leave a gap just like before. If you hold down the Shift key while clicking Delete, the subsequent audio will automatically shift forward to fill the gap. However, this will cause the two people's conversation to lose sync again. Finally , if we hold down Ctrl or Command + Delete, it will move all clips on all tracks forward to fill the gap, which is very convenient for shortening the whole program.

Let's listen to the edited segment. >> It’s like going back to your father's generation. >> Could you talk a bit more about your father's generation? >> OK, after editing, there are usually some split lines left between the clips . If you find them a bit distracting, just hold down the Control key and select the adjacent clips together. Then perform a merge; the shortcut is Ctrl or Command + J, which allows you to stitch these clips back into one complete audio track. Alright, let's continue listening to the.

# 使用壓縮器與增幅調整音量

next part. >> My dad used to ride his bike to Yancheng for work. There's a passage in the book about the sound of old cars, and when I read that part, I really got teary-eyed. >> I get it; some books just really hit home. >> It made my wife cry. >> Right, here the old man is talking about his dad riding a bike; his tone was originally quite sentimental and soft. But later, when he gets emotional, the volume suddenly spikes and becomes very loud. To solve this issue of fluctuating. volume, we can apply a compressor from the effects menu above. A compressor can narrow the gap between the loud and soft parts. The higher the ratio value, the more consistent the overall volume becomes. After processing, if some parts are still a bit too quiet, we can use a command called "Gain." Simply put, it increases the volume. For example, boost it by three decibels. This way, the old man's voice will become much more stable. As for A-Yun's track, it also has low volume, so we go to the effects menu and use "Gain" as. well, perhaps boosting it by six decibels, which is about twice the original volume. This makes the waveforms of both audio tracks look about the same. OK, let's go back and listen to the beginning of the program. >> Hello everyone, welcome to the Lane Reading Club. I'm A-Yun, the owner of Lane Bookstore. >> Right, although A-Yun's volume is sufficient now, his voice still sounds a bit muffled and not clear enough. For this, we can use a very practical tool called the Parametric Equalizer. This tool can be used to adjust the.

# 使用曲線等化器改善人聲

volume of different frequencies in the audio. At the top, it provides many built-in presets, for example, simulating the sound coming from an old telephone receiver. >> Hello everyone, welcome to the Lane Reading Club. I'm A-Yun, the owner of Lane Bookstore. >> Alright, to make the vocals sound more like a professional studio recording, we can make a few simple adjustments. First, in the low-frequency area, below about 100 Hz, you can drag the line straight to the bottom, because this range mostly contains low-frequency noise. Next, in the low-mid frequency. range of about 200 to 400 Hz, we can pull it down slightly to reduce that muffled sound. Then, in the high-mid range to the right, around 3,000 to 5,000 Hz, we can boost it slightly to create a slope, making the sound clearer and brighter. Alright, let's compare: Hello everyone, welcome to the Lane Reading Club, I'm A-Yun, owner of the Lane Bookstore. Hello everyone, welcome to the Lane Reading Club, I'm A-Yun, owner of the Lane Bookstore. >> Great, once you've adjusted the settings and it sounds good, just click "Apply" in the bottom right corner and you're. all set. Now, A-Yun plans to add an intro track and an opening voiceover at the very beginning of the show. To avoid losing track of these timestamps while moving audio clips, A-Yun decides to add a label track to the interface and drag it to the top. The intro music is expected to be about 10 seconds long; after selecting this range, click "Add Label" to give it a name. As for the opening voiceover, it's expected to start at the two-second mark . After adjusting the playhead position,.

# 新增標籤規劃片頭

click "Add Label" again to create a simple marker at this point in time. Next, we can prepare to assemble the intro. The music needs an independent stereo track, which A-Yun places right below the label track. Then, for the opening voiceover audio track, you can use a mono track. The order should be right below the intro music track. Once the tracks are ready, we can drag in the pre-prepared music material and align it to the zero-second mark. Then, drag in the opening voiceover and. align it to the two-second label. Also, don't forget to push A-Yun and Lao Chen's main episode clip back to the 10 -second mark, so the show content officially begins after the intro ends. Alright, let's listen to the intro. Now, if you feel the tempo is a bit off , you can select the clip and drag the clock icon at the edge to speed up the. music automatically without changing the pitch. Let's listen one more time. Generally, when the intro voiceover starts, the background music needs to be turned down so it doesn't drown out the host's voice. So, here we can go to the top and enable the envelope tool. It allows you to create control points on the volume line to locally increase or decrease the volume of the clip. If you click the wrong spot, just.

# 使用波封工具調整音量

double-click the left mouse button on the extra control point to quickly remove it. Alright, let's try again. This is the Corner Book Club, where we chat about a good book every week at a small bookstore in Yancheng, Kaohsiung. Okay, so after the 10-second mark, the intro music should gradually fade out. So, we can continue to create control points on the volume line to give the music a natural fade-out effect. When editing audio, some people like to.

# 加入殘響與延遲效果

use interesting spatial sound effects. Here, I’ll use a short clip to demonstrate. The first effect is called Reverb, which simulates sound reflections in spaces of different sizes. For instance, let’s try the "Medium Room " template. >> This is the Corner Book Club. >> Alright, the next effect is called Delay . For example, here I will select the last word of "Book Club"(Hui). Then, go to the Effects menu and run the Delay effect. Click apply, and this will make the word. "Hui" repeat a few times before it disappears: This is the Corner Book Club . >> Okay, in the latter part of the show, A-Yun has a special segment where we play voice messages from our bookstore readers. Let's take a listen. >> Next, we have a message from a reader who doesn't want to disclose their identity. Let's listen together. >> Alright, so after positioning the playhead here, we drag the reader's message in and place it on a new audio track.

# 改變人聲音高

Then, we select both A-Yun and the old segments simultaneously. Press Ctrl or Command + I to split them, and move their response to the end of the message segment. Since this reader doesn't want to be recognized by acquaintances, we go to the Effects menu and run the Change Pitch effect. For example, we'll raise the reader's voice by four semitones to change their vocal tone. Let’s have a listen. Hi, A-Yun, I have a question. I buy a lot of books but never have time to read them. What would Teacher Chen suggest? Thank. you. >> Teacher Chen, how would you answer this reader? >> Alright, the whole episode is now edited , and we can finally prepare to export it as an MP3 file. You should save this project first to preserve all audio tracks and edit states. Then, go to the File menu and execute the Export Audio command. Merge all audio tracks into a high-quality WAV file and click export. To ensure listeners have a consistent volume when listening to different episodes, we can create a new project here and re-import the merged audio file.

# 響度正規化與限制器

. Next, go back to the Effects menu and run Loudness Normalization. For podcasts , the standard for loudness can be set to -16 LUFS. Click apply. Finally, to prevent occasional loud sentences in the program from causing distortion. We can apply a real-time effect on this track called a limiter; as soon as it detects the volume peak exceeding our set limit, Audacity will automatically compress the audio to prevent distortion . After verifying that everything is correct, we can click to export the. audio again. This time, we can change the export format to MP3. At the same time, you can click the edit button in the lower left corner to fill in the episode title, host name, and channel name, then click export. Your very first podcast episode is now complete and ready to be uploaded to major platforms to share with your listeners. Alright, that wraps up our introduction to Audacity for today. See you next time!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FckfSD6Y3Zs

值得閱讀的理由

  • 快速了解 Audacity 4.0 全新現代化深色介面與錄音前置設定技巧。
  • 學會處理多軌 Podcast 錄音常見的冷氣低頻雜音與雙麥克風串音問題。
  • 掌握音訊非破壞性剪輯、多軌同步、壓縮器平衡音量及等化器人聲修飾等實用音訊後製技巧。

摘要

全新介面與專案基礎設定

作者以經營「街角書店」的主角「阿雲」為例，示範如何使用最新發布的免費音訊編輯工具 Audacity 4.0 來製作 Podcast 節目。阿雲完成軟體安裝後，建立了全新專案並切換至舒適的現代化深色主題（Dark）。作者說明，開始錄音前僅需確認播放裝置與錄音裝置兩項關鍵設定，搭配空白鍵播放與循環播放（Loop Playback）功能，即可輕鬆反覆聆聽與確認錄製的聲音片段。

多軌音訊匯入與雜音清除法

阿雲將書店對談的原音檔案匯入時間軸，並調整軌道名稱與波形高度以利視覺化操作。在對話中，作者發現背景伴隨著持續的冷氣低頻雜音，因此示範選取雜音片段進行降噪（Noise Reduction）採樣與套用。此外，針對來賓麥克風收到阿雲聲音的串音（Crosstalk）現象，阿雲藉由噪聲門（Noise Gate）指令迅速消除閾值以下的微弱人聲干擾，並搭配靜音（Silence）功能將殘留的頑固噪點徹底歸零。

精準剪輯與多軌同步維護

錄音過程中難免會有吃螺絲或清喉嚨等多餘片段，作者展示了直接拖曳邊緣的非破壞性編輯，以及運用美工刀工具（Razor Tool）或快速鍵切割音軌的技巧。為了防止剪去失誤段落後導致雙方問答節奏脫節，阿雲將兩軌片段進行群組（Group）綁定，確保對話能同步移動；同時解說了保留間隙、單軌遞補與全軌遞補三種刪除模式的差異，最後再以合併（Merge）功能將剪輯後的零碎片段無縫縫合。

動態音量平衡與等化器人聲優化

訪談時來賓情緒起伏常導致音量忽大忽小，阿雲套用壓縮器（Compressor）壓縮動態範圍，拉近大聲與小聲之間的差距，並利用增益（Gain）適度提升整體音量，使雙方音軌波形達到均衡。最後，面對聲音偏悶且不夠透亮的問題，作者指引阿雲開啟參數等化器（Parametric Equalizer），將 100 Hz 以下無用的低頻雜音直接濾除，讓 Podcast 訪談人聲呈現如同專業錄音室般的清晰質感。

The order should be right below the intro music track. Once the tracks are ready, we can drag in the pre-prepared music material and align it to the zero-second mark. Then, drag in the opening voiceover and. align it to the two-second label. Also, don't forget to push A-Yun and Lao Chen's main episode clip back to the 10 -second mark, so the show content officially begins after the intro ends. Alright, let's listen to the intro. Now, if you feel the tempo is a bit off , you can select the clip and drag the clock icon at the edge to speed up the. music automatically without changing the pitch. Let's listen one more time. Generally, when the intro voiceover starts, the background music needs to be turned down so it doesn't drown out the host's voice. So, here we can go to the top and enable the envelope tool. It allows you to create control points on the volume line to locally increase or decrease the volume of the clip. If you click the wrong spot, just.

# 使用波封工具調整音量

double-click the left mouse button on the extra control point to quickly remove it. Alright, let's try again. This is the Corner Book Club, where we chat about a good book every week at a small bookstore in Yancheng, Kaohsiung. Okay, so after the 10-second mark, the intro music should gradually fade out. So, we can continue to create control points on the volume line to give the music a natural fade-out effect. When editing audio, some people like to.

# 加入殘響與延遲效果

use interesting spatial sound effects. Here, I’ll use a short clip to demonstrate. The first effect is called Reverb, which simulates sound reflections in spaces of different sizes. For instance, let’s try the "Medium Room " template. >> This is the Corner Book Club. >> Alright, the next effect is called Delay . For example, here I will select the last word of "Book Club"(Hui). Then, go to the Effects menu and run the Delay effect. Click apply, and this will make the word. "Hui" repeat a few times before it disappears: This is the Corner Book Club . >> Okay, in the latter part of the show, A-Yun has a special segment where we play voice messages from our bookstore readers. Let's take a listen. >> Next, we have a message from a reader who doesn't want to disclose their identity. Let's listen together. >> Alright, so after positioning the playhead here, we drag the reader's message in and place it on a new audio track.

# 改變人聲音高

Then, we select both A-Yun and the old segments simultaneously. Press Ctrl or Command + I to split them, and move their response to the end of the message segment. Since this reader doesn't want to be recognized by acquaintances, we go to the Effects menu and run the Change Pitch effect. For example, we'll raise the reader's voice by four semitones to change their vocal tone. Let’s have a listen. Hi, A-Yun, I have a question. I buy a lot of books but never have time to read them. What would Teacher Chen suggest? Thank. you. >> Teacher Chen, how would you answer this reader? >> Alright, the whole episode is now edited , and we can finally prepare to export it as an MP3 file. You should save this project first to preserve all audio tracks and edit states. Then, go to the File menu and execute the Export Audio command. Merge all audio tracks into a high-quality WAV file and click export. To ensure listeners have a consistent volume when listening to different episodes, we can create a new project here and re-import the merged audio file.

# 響度正規化與限制器

. Next, go back to the Effects menu and run Loudness Normalization. For podcasts , the standard for loudness can be set to -16 LUFS. Click apply. Finally, to prevent occasional loud sentences in the program from causing distortion. We can apply a real-time effect on this track called a limiter; as soon as it detects the volume peak exceeding our set limit, Audacity will automatically compress the audio to prevent distortion . After verifying that everything is correct, we can click to export the. audio again. This time, we can change the export format to MP3. At the same time, you can click the edit button in the lower left corner to fill in the episode title, host name, and channel name, then click export. Your very first podcast episode is now complete and ready to be uploaded to major platforms to share with your listeners. Alright, that wraps up our introduction to Audacity for today. 值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解新型多角色協作 AI 助理 GBot 的運作概念，擺脫單一助理的限制，打造專屬虛擬團隊。
  • 學習如何利用 GBot 整合日常生活工具（如 Gmail、Google 日曆）與自動化排程，大幅減輕時間管理負擔。
  • 掌握 AI 團隊的「全域記憶」與「個別記憶」機制，以及如何授權 AI 處理電腦本機檔案與批次閱讀論文。

摘要

打造專屬的 AI 虛擬團隊

作者指出，GBot 與傳統單打獨鬥的 ChatGPT 或 Claude 不同，它能讓使用者組建具備多元專長與性格的虛擬團隊，並支援電腦與手機雙平台。作者以大四學生「小美」為例，說明她面對繁重的課業、打工以及準備澳洲交換學生的高門檻時，如何透過 GBot 建立團隊來分擔瑣碎事務。小美首先建立了樂觀有朝氣的團隊窗口「佳佳」，並直接授權串接 Gmail 處理信件；接著又建立了細心的「叫媽媽」負責把關 Google 日曆 行程，防止錯過任何截止期限。

客製化成員角色與介面管理

除了日常行政，小美還打造了負責查找文獻與翻譯的「研究博士」，以及專門規劃雅思單字測驗的嚴格教練「魔鬼上校」。作者說明，使用者可以替每位機器人自訂名稱、標籤，並透過 AI 生成或上傳自訂頭像；若成員眾多，還能運用分組功能與置頂功能來管理側邊欄。在任務分派上，小美只要透過主要窗口「佳佳」輸入「@」標註特定成員，就能跨角色下達指令，自動將行程登記至日曆中。

雙層記憶架構與自動化排程任務

作者特別解析了 GBot 獨特的記憶架構：包含所有成員共享的全域記憶（記錄使用者的生活背景與大目標），以及僅限單一對話的個別記憶。有趣的是，雖然個別記憶不互通，但機器人彼此間能透過對話交流、拼湊資訊。此外，各個機器人皆具備主動建立排程任務的能力，例如「叫媽媽」會每日檢查期限並定時回報天氣，「魔鬼上校」能按時推送測驗並依需求轉換為互動式測驗網頁，「研究博士」則可在每天早晨主動搜尋並整理學術文獻。

本機檔案讀取與高效批次處理

GBot 不僅限於雲端運作，還能取得授權存取電腦本機資料。小美將電腦存取權限設為每次詢問後，便讓「研究博士」自動讀取混亂的本機文獻，依照文章標題重新命名 PDF 並按課程分類。面對大量的英文資料，GBot 更展現出突破性的多工能力，能同時為多份檔案生成中文摘要，展現遠勝一般 AI 的強大協同作業效率。

================================================

# Grok Bot 下載與安裝

Hi, everyone. Today, let's talk about the increasingly popular AI assistant, GBot. Unlike the ChatGPT or Claude we usually use, GBot isn't just one AI assistant working alone; it's a virtual team on standby. Each teammate has a different personality and specialty, and they can collaborate to help you handle various tasks. GBot can be used on computers and mobile phones, and the official site offers a seven-day free trial. Subscription. Alright, let's. assume our story's protagonist is Xiaomei, a 21-year-old senior student majoring in business administration. Besides being busy with schoolwork, she also takes on three tutoring jobs to earn some living expenses. Xiaomei hopes to go to Australia as an exchange student next year, so she needs an IELTS score of 6.5 and must pass the school's selection process. With so much to do, Xiaomei feels spread thin, so she decides to use GBot to assemble an AI team and delegate her fragmented tasks. To download GBot, we can go to its official website and click the. download button. If you want to download the mobile app, you can simply go to the App Store and search for the keyword. After the download is complete , you can double-click the installer to run it. Then click login, register an account using your Gmail or your preferred method, then follow the on-screen instructions to enable the seven-day trial and register a credit card. Now we can start experiencing all of GBot's features. When the GBot main interface opens, it will automatically help us create our first bot. Xiaomei.

# 建立 Bot 與授權 Google 服務

names this bot "Jiajia" and sets its personality to be optimistic, energetic , and great at encouraging others. Once Jiajia has a new identity, it immediately asks Xiaomei if she wants to connect her Gmail to help manage emails; if she agrees, she just clicks the authorize button. After email authorization is complete, Xiaomei intends to continue by creating a second bot. So, Xiaomei designs a prompt to name the second bot "Mama" and describes her as very caring. If there are any deadlines on Xiaomei's. calendar, Mama will remind her three days in advance. After writing the prompt, Xiaomei clicks the submit button to send it. Mama notices that Xiaomei's Gmail is connected, but her Google Calendar is not yet linked, so Mama urges Xiaomei to log in to her account quickly to avoid missing important schedules and deadlines. If Xiaomei wants to check which services she has connected later, she can click on "Connected Apps" in the bottom left corner. This page lists all the apps that Coze bots can connect to. By clicking "Connect" in the top right. corner, we can find the Gmail and Google Calendar we just set up. You can also return here at any time to uninstall these tools. Alright, the third bot we plan to create is called Dr. Research. Dr. Research’s main job is to help Xiao Mei find information online, translate it into Chinese, and check her reports for any gaps. It acts as a rigorous academic research assistant. To fully prepare for her IELTS exam, Xiao Mei also created a fourth bot called Colonel Drill. He is a strict coach responsible for. scheduling daily vocabulary tests for Xiao Mei and analyzing her mock exam scores, aiming for a high IELTS total band score. So, Xiao Mei’s team now has four members. To make them easier to distinguish, she plans to change the avatar for each bot. In the information panel on the right, besides renaming them, Xiao Mei can also set a label for each teammate—for example, Jiajia is a captain who always gets the job done. Xiao Mei just needs to click on Jiajia’s avatar to change its appearance. For example, you can apply.

# 更換 Bot 頭像

a brighter color. If you want a more personalized icon, we can switch to the "Generate" tab. Here, you can use AI to generate a bot avatar, such as a robot with large LED eyes. Click "Generate." If you aren't satisfied, uploading an image file from your computer is no problem at all. You just need to drag the image from your folder into the right-hand pane, and that’s it. Alright, I've now updated the avatars for all the bots using the same method. As the number of bots grows, if you.

# 整理 Bot 與分區

want to organize them, you can right-click on a bot and select "Move to new section." For instance, categorize Dr. Research under the " Academics" section. Then, drag Colonel Drill, who is responsible for the IELTS exam, into that same section. If you accidentally drag the wrong one, it doesn’t matter. We just need to drag it back to its original position, and that’s fine. Additionally, for frequently used bots, you can consider dragging them to the dashed area at the very top, which will pin the bot to the top of the sidebar. You will notice an orange star in the bottom right corner. of Jiajia, indicating that he is the first bot Xiao Mei created. He also serves as the main point of contact for delegating tasks to other AI assistants . For example, Xiao Mei introduces herself to Jiajia in the chat, explaining her current situation. Next, Xiao-Mei wants to ask Jia-Jia to have Jiao-Ma-Ma register the school selection date on her calendar. To specifically mention a certain bot, we can use the "@" symbol on the keyboard to bring up the list of AI assistants, allowing us to quickly load Jiao-Ma-Ma's name. After inputting it,. Xiao-Mei presses the Enter key to send the command. Upon receiving the task, Jia-Jia will directly relay the message to Jiao-Ma-Ma, asking her to register the schedule. A short while later, Xiao-Mei can see the school selection schedule on her calendar. This point-of-contact role doesn't have to be held by the first bot. If needed, you can also use the right-click menu to change it to another AI assistant to serve as the primary contact window. Alright, next, let’s get to know the memory mechanism of the bots. Bot memory is divided into two types: one is the "global memory" shared by all.

# 全域記憶與個別記憶

bots, used to remember your personal information and life background. The other is "individual memory," which is the chat history between you and a specific AI assistant that other bots cannot access. For example, when Xiao-Mei was introducing herself earlier, she mentioned to Jia-Jia her plan to go to Australia as an exchange student. If Xiao-Mei comes to the " Devil Colonel" chat room and asks him directly which country she wants to go to as an exchange student, the Devil Colonel can immediately answer " Australia." At this point, the Devil Colonel asks Xiao-Mei, "What is your current IELTS score?" Xiao-Mei tells. the Devil Colonel her last mock exam score and gets scolded. However, if Xiao-Mei then goes to Jiao-Ma-Ma and asks, "Do you know my last IELTS mock score?" You will find that Jiao-Ma-Ma is unaware, because the conversation regarding the IELTS score is only stored in the Devil Colonel's individual memory. Interestingly, although Jiao-Ma-Ma doesn't know Xiao-Mei’s score, she can go and ask the Devil Colonel. In other words, even though individual memories are not shared, bots can still exchange information through conversation, piecing together information dispersed. among different teammates. You will see a task called "Daily Deadline Check" in the information bar on the right. This is a daily routine that Jiao-Ma-Ma proactively created after Xiao-Mei previously instructed her to remind her of all deadlines. Xiao-Mei can continue to request other routine tasks, such as asking Jiao-Ma-Ma to tell her the daily weather and whether she needs an umbrella every morning at 7:00 AM. Upon receiving this, Jiao-Ma-Ma will immediately create the second task schedule in the sidebar. If you ever find that the information bar on the.

# 設定每日排程任務

right is hidden, you can click on the bot's avatar at the top. Then, switch to "Details." Colonel Devil has also proactively set up a daily vocabulary quiz schedule for himself. If you find this time isn't ideal, we can ask Colonel Devil to adjust it, for instance, to your lunch break. Alright, the scheduled task can also be combined with web information searches. For example, Xiaomei can ask Dr. Bot to go online every morning at 8:00 AM. To look for new articles related to her school report. This way, as soon as. Xiaomei opens her computer, she receives the organized, latest literature immediately. Alright, it is now 12:00 PM, and Colonel Devil has sent today's IELTS vocabulary quiz right on time. However, it is currently just a plain text test paper, which isn't very convenient to fill out. Therefore, Xiaomei asks Colonel Devil to change it into an interactive quiz webpage. After Colonel Devil approves, he starts the transformation, so Xiaomei can answer like playing a game on the web; incorrect answers are automatically recorded and reported, making it much easier for Xiaomei to. practice. Well, besides operating in the cloud, the bot can also access local files on our computers. For instance, to work on a school report, Xiaomei downloaded several PDF files from the internet. But the filenames were all a mess, making it impossible to tell which file was which article, so Xiaomei opened the Gockbot settings dialog in the bottom left corner. She switched to the computer tab. Then she changed the Gockbot permission for computer access from "Never allow" to " Ask every time." Once set, Xiaomei.

# 整理電腦中的本機檔案

could ask Dr. Bot to access her computer, rename each PDF file using its article title, and sort them by course name. Since the permission is set to "Ask every time," a notification pops up on the screen requesting authorization; once you click allow, Dr. Bot will organize all the files neatly for you. Alright, although the files are now organized, every document is in English, and it might take Xiaomei an entire night just to finish reading one. For this, Xiaomei can also ask Dr. Bot for a favor, such as. requesting a 300-word Chinese summary for a specific article. Even summarizing all the documents in the folder at once is no problem, because unlike GPT, which can only handle one question at a time in a conversation, G-Bot is different. You can assign multiple tasks at any time without waiting for the previous one to finish; the bot will process them in parallel and report the progress of whichever one finishes first. Alright, Dr. Bot has finished preparing the Excel file. With this table, Xiao-Mei can compare the key points of each article and gain. a clearer understanding of the topic. Alright, GCKB has a very interesting feature called Group Chat. For example, in an elective course Xiao-Mei is taking, she needs to debate in class whether AI makes students lazy. Xiao-Mei wants to know what angles the opposing side might use to attack, so she plans to create bots of several historical figures to join the discussion. The first is a legend in the tech world, Apple founder Steve Jobs. The second is the great Ming Dynasty thinker Wang Yangming, who advocated for the unity of knowledge and action. The third is the ancient Greek philosopher Socrates, who is.

# 建立群組聊天

skilled at asking questions to force others to clarify their points. After setting up these three figures, Xiao-Mei can select "Create Group Chat" from the plus menu and add these three bots into the chat room one by one. Then, she asks Socrates to act as the moderator, Wang Yangming to represent the affirmative, and Jobs to represent the opposition, debating whether AI makes students lazy. After sending the prompt, Xiao-Mei can watch these three figures engage in a brilliant exchange within the chat room. From this, Xiao-Mei can find many arguments that. she can include in her report. After the discussion, if you feel the sidebar has too many bots and looks too crowded , you can right-click on the bots you don't need for now and choose to hide or delete them, making the sidebar look cleaner and simpler. Alright, one day, Xiao-Mei received a letter from one of her tutoring students. A girl named Xiao-Yu encountered a math problem she couldn't solve during a school exam, so she wrote for help. Since it's hard to explain math problems clearly in text, Xiao-Mei decided to send the problem directly to Jia-Jia, asking her to. design a simple and easy-to-understand animation for the explanation. Xiao-Mei heard that Google's Gemini model sounds very realistic and natural, so she specifically requested to use this model to generate the voiceover. However, to use this voice model, one must apply for a password, which is a so-called API key. Therefore, Xiao-Mei went to the Google AI Studio website. Click on the key icon. Then, click on " Create API key" in the top right corner . The screen will display a password consisting of letters and numbers. We.

can copy it, return to the GCKB interface, and paste the key into the text field in the card. Click "Save Safely." With that, Jia-Jia will immediately begin creating the math problem-solving animation. Alright, let's take a look at the finished video . >> The problem gives us three conditions. First, BE equals AF; we mark this in blue. Second, angle BED equals angle AFC; we use orange for this. >> Okay, Xiao Mei plans to upload the. finished animation to YouTube as an unlisted video and send the link to her student, Xiao Yu. Upon hearing this, Jiajia proactively opened the browser on the cloud computer and asked Xiao Mei to log in to YouTube herself. After Xiao Mei entered her account and password and clicked the finish button, Jiajia took over to complete the upload process and publish the video to YouTube. A little while later, after Jiajia obtained the video's sharing link, Xiao Mei prepared to reply to her student, Xiao Yu. So, Xiao Mei asked. Jiajia to draft the email first and then hand it over to Mama, who is responsible for emails and scheduling. If the email content looks good, we click "No problem." If Xiao Mei switches to Mama's side, she will see an email reply window where the content can be freely edited or deleted. If you feel that a second check is unnecessary , you can disable this draft function. Finally, click send to dispatch the email. Alright, besides approving drafts, you can actually set default.

# 設定自訂規則

handling methods for any of B's actions . Just scroll down the screen to find the rule-setting section, and you can enter the actions you want to regulate in the fields. For example, when making payments or checking out, B must ask us first. Also, if files need to be deleted from the computer, it must require our approval and cannot be executed rashly on its own. Well, although Mama can help Xiao Mei manage emails, there is a small issue: Gmail cannot notify us immediately upon receiving a new message, so Mama can.

# 設定專屬信箱與 Gmail 轉寄

only check the inbox at fixed intervals . To solve this, there is a clever workaround: ask the AI assistant to apply for a dedicated GlockB email address. This mailbox can notify our B the moment a new email is received. Once the application is done, we also need to set up forwarding in Gmail. You can find it on the settings page by switching to the forwarding tab. Then click "Add an address" and enter the Graftb email address we just applied for into the text field. Click "Next," and the system will immediately send a confirmation email. Once we receive it, we just need to click the confirmation link in the message to complete the email forwarding setup. Alright, Xiao Mei now feels it might not be necessary to forward every single email to the dedicated GlockB mailbox. So, she decided to set up a filter in Gmail so that only emails from her student, Xiao Yu, would be forwarded to the Gockbot mailbox, allowing Gockbot to notify her immediately. Alright, Xiao Mei realized that the process from receiving a student's math problem to creating the.

# 將流程儲存成技能

video, uploading it to YouTube, and finally sending the reply is basically a fixed routine. Therefore, Xiao Mei decided to ask Gockbot to save this sequence as a "skill," effectively creating a standard operating procedure . As long as the specific trigger conditions are met, the skill will start automatically. If you have created multiple skills and want to review them one by one, you can click on "Connected Apps." Then, go to the top right corner and click on " Connected." This way, you can see the list of skills you've created down below. Once you click into them, you can view and modify the contents of the. skills. As for skills that are no longer needed, we can also delete them at any time. With this skill in place, if Xiao Yu sends another email asking a math question, the system will automatically trigger this skill. Gockbot will then generate the solution video, upload it to YouTube, and finally have Gockbot send the email— no intervention from Xiao Mei is needed at all. Besides manually writing skills , Gockbot also offers a very convenient feature called "Teach a Task." Simply put, you perform the actions yourself. on Gockbot's cloud computer, allowing the bot to learn your steps directly. For example, Xiao Mei sometimes needs to return to the dorm late due to events, so she usually has to go to the school dormitory website to register. Finally, she submits. the form. Then, she clicks the stop recording button in the top right corner. Just like that, Gockbot has learned how to help Xiao Mei fill out the late return form. Later, if Xiao Mei ever needs to register for a late return while she's out, she just needs to pick up her phone, open the Gockbot app, and use the voice function to tell Gockbot; it will then open the cloud computer on its own and complete the late return registration for her. Alright, that's all for our introduction to Gockbot today. See you next time, bye!

  • 掌握 AI 團隊的「全域記憶」與「個別記憶」機制，以及如何授權 AI 處理電腦本機檔案與批次閱讀論文。

除了日常行政，小美還打造了負責查找文獻與翻譯的「研究博士」，以及專門規劃雅思單字測驗的嚴格教練「魔鬼上校」。作者說明，使用者可以替每位機器人自訂名稱、標籤，並透過 AI 生成或上傳自訂頭像；若成員眾多，還能運用分組功能與置頂功能來管理側邊欄。在任務分派上，小美只要透過主要窗口「佳佳」輸入「@」標註特定成員，就能跨角色下達指令，自動將行程登記至日曆中。

雙層記憶架構與自動化排程任務

GBot 不僅限於雲端運作，還能取得授權存取電腦本機資料。小美將電腦存取權限設為每次詢問後，便讓「研究博士」自動讀取混亂的本機文獻，依照文章標題重新命名 PDF 並按課程分類。面對大量的英文資料，GBot 更展現出突破性的多工能力，能同時為多份檔案生成中文摘要，展現遠勝一般 AI 的強大協同作業效率。

Unlike the ChatGPT or Claude we usually use, GBot isn't just one AI assistant working alone; it's a virtual team on standby. Each teammate has a different personality and specialty, and they can collaborate to help you handle various tasks. GBot can be used on computers and mobile phones, and the official site offers a seven-day free trial. Subscription. Alright, let's. assume our story's protagonist is Xiaomei, a 21-year-old senior student majoring in business administration. Besides being busy with schoolwork, she also takes on three tutoring jobs to earn some living expenses. Xiaomei hopes to go to Australia as an exchange student next year, so she needs an IELTS score of 6.5 and must pass the school's selection process. names this bot "Jiajia" and sets its personality to be optimistic, energetic , and great at encouraging others. Once Jiajia has a new identity, it immediately asks Xiaomei if she wants to connect her Gmail to help manage emails; if she agrees, she just clicks the authorize button. After email authorization is complete, Xiaomei intends to continue by creating a second bot. So, Xiaomei designs a prompt to name the second bot "Mama" and describes her as very caring. If there are any deadlines on Xiaomei's. calendar, Mama will remind her three days in advance. After writing the prompt, Xiaomei clicks the submit button to send it. Mama notices that Xiaomei's Gmail is connected, but her Google Calendar is not yet linked, so Mama urges Xiaomei to log in to her account quickly to avoid missing important schedules and deadlines. If Xiaomei wants to check which services she has connected later, she can click on "Connected Apps" in the bottom left corner. This page lists all the apps that Coze bots can connect to. By clicking "Connect" in the top right. corner, we can find the Gmail and Google Calendar we just set up. You can also return here at any time to uninstall these tools. Xiao Mei just needs to click on Jiajia’s avatar to change its appearance. For example, you can apply.

a brighter color. If you want a more personalized icon, we can switch to the "Generate" tab. Here, you can use AI to generate a bot avatar, such as a robot with large LED eyes. Click "Generate." want to organize them, you can right-click on a bot and select "Move to new section." For instance, categorize Dr. Research under the " Academics" section. We just need to drag it back to its original position, and that’s fine. Additionally, for frequently used bots, you can consider dragging them to the dashed area at the very top, which will pin the bot to the top of the sidebar. You will notice an orange star in the bottom right corner. of Jiajia, indicating that he is the first bot Xiao Mei created. Next, Xiao-Mei wants to ask Jia-Jia to have Jiao-Ma-Ma register the school selection date on her calendar. To specifically mention a certain bot, we can use the "@" symbol on the keyboard to bring up the list of AI assistants, allowing us to quickly load Jiao-Ma-Ma's name. After inputting it,. Xiao-Mei presses the Enter key to send the command. Upon receiving the task, Jia-Jia will directly relay the message to Jiao-Ma-Ma, asking her to register the schedule. A short while later, Xiao-Mei can see the school selection schedule on her calendar. This point-of-contact role doesn't have to be held by the first bot. If needed, you can also use the right-click menu to change it to another AI assistant to serve as the primary contact window. Alright, next, let’s get to know the memory mechanism of the bots. Bot memory is divided into two types: one is the "global memory" shared by all.

# 全域記憶與個別記憶

bots, used to remember your personal information and life background. For example, when Xiao-Mei was introducing herself earlier, she mentioned to Jia-Jia her plan to go to Australia as an exchange student. If Xiao-Mei comes to the " Devil Colonel" chat room and asks him directly which country she wants to go to as an exchange student, the Devil Colonel can immediately answer " Australia." At this point, the Devil Colonel asks Xiao-Mei, "What is your current IELTS score?" Xiao-Mei tells. the Devil Colonel her last mock exam score and gets scolded. However, if Xiao-Mei then goes to Jiao-Ma-Ma and asks, "Do you know my last IELTS mock score?" You will find that Jiao-Ma-Ma is unaware, because the conversation regarding the IELTS score is only stored in the Devil Colonel's individual memory. Interestingly, although Jiao-Ma-Ma doesn't know Xiao-Mei’s score, she can go and ask the Devil Colonel. In other words, even though individual memories are not shared, bots can still exchange information through conversation, piecing together information dispersed. among different teammates. You will see a task called "Daily Deadline Check" in the information bar on the right. This is a daily routine that Jiao-Ma-Ma proactively created after Xiao-Mei previously instructed her to remind her of all deadlines. Xiao-Mei can continue to request other routine tasks, such as asking Jiao-Ma-Ma to tell her the daily weather and whether she needs an umbrella every morning at 7:00 AM. Upon receiving this, Jiao-Ma-Ma will immediately create the second task schedule in the sidebar. If you ever find that the information bar on the.

right is hidden, you can click on the bot's avatar at the top. Then, switch to "Details." Colonel Devil has also proactively set up a daily vocabulary quiz schedule for himself. If you find this time isn't ideal, we can ask Colonel Devil to adjust it, for instance, to your lunch break. Alright, the scheduled task can also be combined with web information searches. For example, Xiaomei can ask Dr. Bot to go online every morning at 8:00 AM. To look for new articles related to her school report. This way, as soon as. Xiaomei opens her computer, she receives the organized, latest literature immediately. Alright, it is now 12:00 PM, and Colonel Devil has sent today's IELTS vocabulary quiz right on time. could ask Dr. Bot to access her computer, rename each PDF file using its article title, and sort them by course name. You can assign multiple tasks at any time without waiting for the previous one to finish; the bot will process them in parallel and report the progress of whichever one finishes first. Alright, Dr. Bot has finished preparing the Excel file. With this table, Xiao-Mei can compare the key points of each article and gain. a clearer understanding of the topic. Alright, GCKB has a very interesting feature called Group Chat. For example, in an elective course Xiao-Mei is taking, she needs to debate in class whether AI makes students lazy. The first is a legend in the tech world, Apple founder Steve Jobs. The second is the great Ming Dynasty thinker Wang Yangming, who advocated for the unity of knowledge and action. The third is the ancient Greek philosopher Socrates, who is.

skilled at asking questions to force others to clarify their points. can copy it, return to the GCKB interface, and paste the key into the text field in the card. Click "Save Safely." First, BE equals AF; we mark this in blue. Second, angle BED equals angle AFC; we use orange for this. >> Okay, Xiao Mei plans to upload the. finished animation to YouTube as an unlisted video and send the link to her student, Xiao Yu. Upon hearing this, Jiajia proactively opened the browser on the cloud computer and asked Xiao Mei to log in to YouTube herself. After Xiao Mei entered her account and password and clicked the finish button, Jiajia took over to complete the upload process and publish the video to YouTube. Jiajia to draft the email first and then hand it over to Mama, who is responsible for emails and scheduling. If the email content looks good, we click "No problem." If Xiao Mei switches to Mama's side, she will see an email reply window where the content can be freely edited or deleted. # 設定自訂規則

handling methods for any of B's actions . Just scroll down the screen to find the rule-setting section, and you can enter the actions you want to regulate in the fields. only check the inbox at fixed intervals . To solve this, there is a clever workaround: ask the AI assistant to apply for a dedicated GlockB email address. video, uploading it to YouTube, and finally sending the reply is basically a fixed routine. Then, go to the top right corner and click on " Connected." This way, you can see the list of skills you've created down below. Finally, she submits. the form. Then, she clicks the stop recording button in the top right corner. Just like that, Gockbot has learned how to help Xiao Mei fill out the late return form. Later, if Xiao Mei ever needs to register for a late return while she's out, she just needs to pick up her phone, open the Gockbot app, and use the voice function to tell Gockbot; it will then open the cloud computer on its own and complete the late return registration for her. Alright, that's all for our introduction to Gockbot today. See you next time, bye!

If there are any deadlines on Xiaomei's. calendar, Mama will remind her three days in advance. After writing the prompt, Xiaomei clicks the submit button to send it. Mama notices that Xiaomei's Gmail is connected, but her Google Calendar is not yet linked, so Mama urges Xiaomei to log in to her account quickly to avoid missing important schedules and deadlines. If Xiaomei wants to check which services she has connected later, she can click on "Connected Apps" in the bottom left corner. This page lists all the apps that Coze bots can connect to. By clicking "Connect" in the top right. corner, we can find the Gmail and Google Calendar we just set up. You can also return here at any time to uninstall these tools. Alright, the third bot we plan to create is called Dr. Research. Dr. Research’s main job is to help Xiao Mei find information online, translate it into Chinese, and check her reports for any gaps. It acts as a rigorous academic research assistant. To fully prepare for her IELTS exam, Xiao Mei also created a fourth bot called Colonel Drill. He is a strict coach responsible for. scheduling daily vocabulary tests for Xiao Mei and analyzing her mock exam scores, aiming for a high IELTS total band score. So, Xiao Mei’s team now has four members. To make them easier to distinguish, she plans to change the avatar for each bot. In the information panel on the right, besides renaming them, Xiao Mei can also set a label for each teammate—for example, Jiajia is a captain who always gets the job done. Xiao Mei just needs to click on Jiajia’s avatar to change its appearance. For example, you can apply.

# 更換 Bot 頭像

a brighter color. If you want a more personalized icon, we can switch to the "Generate" tab. Here, you can use AI to generate a bot avatar, such as a robot with large LED eyes. Click "Generate." If you aren't satisfied, uploading an image file from your computer is no problem at all. You just need to drag the image from your folder into the right-hand pane, and that’s it. Alright, I've now updated the avatars for all the bots using the same method. As the number of bots grows, if you.

# 整理 Bot 與分區

want to organize them, you can right-click on a bot and select "Move to new section." For instance, categorize Dr. Research under the " Academics" section. Then, drag Colonel Drill, who is responsible for the IELTS exam, into that same section. If you accidentally drag the wrong one, it doesn’t matter. We just need to drag it back to its original position, and that’s fine. Additionally, for frequently used bots, you can consider dragging them to the dashed area at the very top, which will pin the bot to the top of the sidebar. You will notice an orange star in the bottom right corner. of Jiajia, indicating that he is the first bot Xiao Mei created. He also serves as the main point of contact for delegating tasks to other AI assistants . For example, Xiao Mei introduces herself to Jiajia in the chat, explaining her current situation. Next, Xiao-Mei wants to ask Jia-Jia to have Jiao-Ma-Ma register the school selection date on her calendar. To specifically mention a certain bot, we can use the "@" symbol on the keyboard to bring up the list of AI assistants, allowing us to quickly load Jiao-Ma-Ma's name. After inputting it,. Xiao-Mei presses the Enter key to send the command. Upon receiving the task, Jia-Jia will directly relay the message to Jiao-Ma-Ma, asking her to register the schedule. A short while later, Xiao-Mei can see the school selection schedule on her calendar. This point-of-contact role doesn't have to be held by the first bot. If needed, you can also use the right-click menu to change it to another AI assistant to serve as the primary contact window. Alright, next, let’s get to know the memory mechanism of the bots. Bot memory is divided into two types: one is the "global memory" shared by all.

# 全域記憶與個別記憶

bots, used to remember your personal information and life background. The other is "individual memory," which is the chat history between you and a specific AI assistant that other bots cannot access. For example, when Xiao-Mei was introducing herself earlier, she mentioned to Jia-Jia her plan to go to Australia as an exchange student. If Xiao-Mei comes to the " Devil Colonel" chat room and asks him directly which country she wants to go to as an exchange student, the Devil Colonel can immediately answer " Australia." At this point, the Devil Colonel asks Xiao-Mei, "What is your current IELTS score?" Xiao-Mei tells. the Devil Colonel her last mock exam score and gets scolded. However, if Xiao-Mei then goes to Jiao-Ma-Ma and asks, "Do you know my last IELTS mock score?" You will find that Jiao-Ma-Ma is unaware, because the conversation regarding the IELTS score is only stored in the Devil Colonel's individual memory. Interestingly, although Jiao-Ma-Ma doesn't know Xiao-Mei’s score, she can go and ask the Devil Colonel. In other words, even though individual memories are not shared, bots can still exchange information through conversation, piecing together information dispersed. among different teammates. You will see a task called "Daily Deadline Check" in the information bar on the right. This is a daily routine that Jiao-Ma-Ma proactively created after Xiao-Mei previously instructed her to remind her of all deadlines. Xiao-Mei can continue to request other routine tasks, such as asking Jiao-Ma-Ma to tell her the daily weather and whether she needs an umbrella every morning at 7:00 AM. Upon receiving this, Jiao-Ma-Ma will immediately create the second task schedule in the sidebar. If you ever find that the information bar on the.

# 設定每日排程任務

right is hidden, you can click on the bot's avatar at the top. Then, switch to "Details." Colonel Devil has also proactively set up a daily vocabulary quiz schedule for himself. If you find this time isn't ideal, we can ask Colonel Devil to adjust it, for instance, to your lunch break. Alright, the scheduled task can also be combined with web information searches. For example, Xiaomei can ask Dr. Bot to go online every morning at 8:00 AM. To look for new articles related to her school report. This way, as soon as. Xiaomei opens her computer, she receives the organized, latest literature immediately. Alright, it is now 12:00 PM, and Colonel Devil has sent today's IELTS vocabulary quiz right on time. However, it is currently just a plain text test paper, which isn't very convenient to fill out. Therefore, Xiaomei asks Colonel Devil to change it into an interactive quiz webpage. After Colonel Devil approves, he starts the transformation, so Xiaomei can answer like playing a game on the web; incorrect answers are automatically recorded and reported, making it much easier for Xiaomei to. practice. Well, besides operating in the cloud, the bot can also access local files on our computers. For instance, to work on a school report, Xiaomei downloaded several PDF files from the internet. But the filenames were all a mess, making it impossible to tell which file was which article, so Xiaomei opened the Gockbot settings dialog in the bottom left corner. She switched to the computer tab. Then she changed the Gockbot permission for computer access from "Never allow" to " Ask every time." Once set, Xiaomei.

# 整理電腦中的本機檔案

could ask Dr. Bot to access her computer, rename each PDF file using its article title, and sort them by course name. Since the permission is set to "Ask every time," a notification pops up on the screen requesting authorization; once you click allow, Dr. Bot will organize all the files neatly for you. Alright, although the files are now organized, every document is in English, and it might take Xiaomei an entire night just to finish reading one. For this, Xiaomei can also ask Dr. Bot for a favor, such as. requesting a 300-word Chinese summary for a specific article. Even summarizing all the documents in the folder at once is no problem, because unlike GPT, which can only handle one question at a time in a conversation, G-Bot is different. You can assign multiple tasks at any time without waiting for the previous one to finish; the bot will process them in parallel and report the progress of whichever one finishes first. Alright, Dr. Bot has finished preparing the Excel file. With this table, Xiao-Mei can compare the key points of each article and gain. a clearer understanding of the topic. Alright, GCKB has a very interesting feature called Group Chat. For example, in an elective course Xiao-Mei is taking, she needs to debate in class whether AI makes students lazy. Xiao-Mei wants to know what angles the opposing side might use to attack, so she plans to create bots of several historical figures to join the discussion. The first is a legend in the tech world, Apple founder Steve Jobs. The second is the great Ming Dynasty thinker Wang Yangming, who advocated for the unity of knowledge and action. The third is the ancient Greek philosopher Socrates, who is.

# 建立群組聊天

skilled at asking questions to force others to clarify their points. After setting up these three figures, Xiao-Mei can select "Create Group Chat" from the plus menu and add these three bots into the chat room one by one. Then, she asks Socrates to act as the moderator, Wang Yangming to represent the affirmative, and Jobs to represent the opposition, debating whether AI makes students lazy. After sending the prompt, Xiao-Mei can watch these three figures engage in a brilliant exchange within the chat room. From this, Xiao-Mei can find many arguments that. she can include in her report. After the discussion, if you feel the sidebar has too many bots and looks too crowded , you can right-click on the bots you don't need for now and choose to hide or delete them, making the sidebar look cleaner and simpler. Alright, one day, Xiao-Mei received a letter from one of her tutoring students. A girl named Xiao-Yu encountered a math problem she couldn't solve during a school exam, so she wrote for help. Since it's hard to explain math problems clearly in text, Xiao-Mei decided to send the problem directly to Jia-Jia, asking her to. design a simple and easy-to-understand animation for the explanation. Xiao-Mei heard that Google's Gemini model sounds very realistic and natural, so she specifically requested to use this model to generate the voiceover. However, to use this voice model, one must apply for a password, which is a so-called API key. Therefore, Xiao-Mei went to the Google AI Studio website. Click on the key icon. Then, click on " Create API key" in the top right corner . The screen will display a password consisting of letters and numbers. We.

can copy it, return to the GCKB interface, and paste the key into the text field in the card. Click "Save Safely." With that, Jia-Jia will immediately begin creating the math problem-solving animation. Alright, let's take a look at the finished video . >> The problem gives us three conditions. First, BE equals AF; we mark this in blue. Second, angle BED equals angle AFC; we use orange for this. >> Okay, Xiao Mei plans to upload the. finished animation to YouTube as an unlisted video and send the link to her student, Xiao Yu. Upon hearing this, Jiajia proactively opened the browser on the cloud computer and asked Xiao Mei to log in to YouTube herself. After Xiao Mei entered her account and password and clicked the finish button, Jiajia took over to complete the upload process and publish the video to YouTube. A little while later, after Jiajia obtained the video's sharing link, Xiao Mei prepared to reply to her student, Xiao Yu. So, Xiao Mei asked. Jiajia to draft the email first and then hand it over to Mama, who is responsible for emails and scheduling. If the email content looks good, we click "No problem." If Xiao Mei switches to Mama's side, she will see an email reply window where the content can be freely edited or deleted. If you feel that a second check is unnecessary , you can disable this draft function. Finally, click send to dispatch the email. Alright, besides approving drafts, you can actually set default.

# 設定自訂規則

handling methods for any of B's actions . Just scroll down the screen to find the rule-setting section, and you can enter the actions you want to regulate in the fields. For example, when making payments or checking out, B must ask us first. Also, if files need to be deleted from the computer, it must require our approval and cannot be executed rashly on its own. Well, although Mama can help Xiao Mei manage emails, there is a small issue: Gmail cannot notify us immediately upon receiving a new message, so Mama can.

# 設定專屬信箱與 Gmail 轉寄

only check the inbox at fixed intervals . To solve this, there is a clever workaround: ask the AI assistant to apply for a dedicated GlockB email address. This mailbox can notify our B the moment a new email is received. Once the application is done, we also need to set up forwarding in Gmail. You can find it on the settings page by switching to the forwarding tab. Then click "Add an address" and enter the Graftb email address we just applied for into the text field. Click "Next," and the system will immediately send a confirmation email. Once we receive it, we just need to click the confirmation link in the message to complete the email forwarding setup. Alright, Xiao Mei now feels it might not be necessary to forward every single email to the dedicated GlockB mailbox. So, she decided to set up a filter in Gmail so that only emails from her student, Xiao Yu, would be forwarded to the Gockbot mailbox, allowing Gockbot to notify her immediately. Alright, Xiao Mei realized that the process from receiving a student's math problem to creating the.

# 將流程儲存成技能

video, uploading it to YouTube, and finally sending the reply is basically a fixed routine. Therefore, Xiao Mei decided to ask Gockbot to save this sequence as a "skill," effectively creating a standard operating procedure . As long as the specific trigger conditions are met, the skill will start automatically. If you have created multiple skills and want to review them one by one, you can click on "Connected Apps." Then, go to the top right corner and click on " Connected." This way, you can see the list of skills you've created down below. Once you click into them, you can view and modify the contents of the. skills. As for skills that are no longer needed, we can also delete them at any time. With this skill in place, if Xiao Yu sends another email asking a math question, the system will automatically trigger this skill. Gockbot will then generate the solution video, upload it to YouTube, and finally have Gockbot send the email— no intervention from Xiao Mei is needed at all. Besides manually writing skills , Gockbot also offers a very convenient feature called "Teach a Task." Simply put, you perform the actions yourself. on Gockbot's cloud computer, allowing the bot to learn your steps directly. For example, Xiao Mei sometimes needs to return to the dorm late due to events, so she usually has to go to the school dormitory website to register. Now with Gockbot, Xiao Mei can click the plus sign in the bottom left corner and select "Teach a Task," which will automatically open the cloud computer. Then, Xiao Mei clicks "Start Recording" in the top right corner and can demonstrate going to the school dormitory website, filling in her name, student ID, date, and reason for late return in order. Finally, she submits. the form. Then, she clicks the stop recording button in the top right corner. Just like that, Gockbot has learned how to help Xiao Mei fill out the late return form. Later, if Xiao Mei ever needs to register for a late return while she's out, she just needs to pick up her phone, open the Gockbot app, and use the voice function to tell Gockbot; it will then open the cloud computer on its own and complete the late return registration for her. Alright, that's all for our introduction to Gockbot today. See you next time, bye!

=============

item.title: 免 AI 訂閱！用 Excel 輕鬆實現自動化！Power Query 手把手基礎教學，一鍵自動清理所有雜亂資料！
item.itunes:title: 免 AI 訂閱！用 Excel 輕鬆實現自動化！Power Query 手把手基礎教學，一鍵自動清理所有雜亂資料！
item.itunes:author: PAPAYA 電腦教室
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3nuFa5yEvvQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 Excel 內建且完全免費的 Power Query 工具，無需訂閱額外 AI 服務即可實現資料自動化清理。
  • 學習實用的資料整理技巧，包括取消樞紐、處理空白值與格式錯誤、資料合併以及利用反向聯結精準抓出人為輸入疏失。
  • 掌握自動監控資料夾多個檔案與一鍵重新整理的技巧，輕鬆打造包含銷售分析與低庫存警示的自動化營運報表系統。

摘要

Power Query 概念與基本資料轉換

作者以經營手搖飲料店的主角「小明」為例，介紹如何運用 Excel 中的 Power Query 整合不同來源且格式混亂的資料。作者指出，Power Query 就像廚房處理食材的自動化流程，能匯入 Excel、資料夾等多種來源並記錄所有清洗步驟。小明將「門市記錄」等表格匯入後，先將原本不易供電腦運算分析的橫向寬表透過取消其他資料行的樞紐轉為直向表格，並迅速移除多餘的標題列與空白行，讓雜亂的銷售資料變得整潔標準。

資料類型校正與銷售明細計算

在清理銷售數據的過程中，作者展示了如何利用資料行品質檢測出文字輸入錯誤，並以取代功能將代表缺貨的橫線修正為數字 0 以免運算報錯。接著，作者示範利用從範例建立資料行推算出星期，並以「參考」方式複製查詢，透過合併查詢功能帶入價目表中的商品售價。針對因字尾多餘空白導致抓不到價格的問題，小明利用修剪功能快速修復，順利計算出每項商品的營業額，最後再透過樞紐資料行重組出便於主管閱覽的每日營業額合計報表。

人工輸入防呆查錯與資料夾批次整合

針對店員記錄領料時的疏忽，小明利用向下填滿補齊日期，並藉由分隔符號分割原料名稱與編號。面對人為鍵入錯誤的原料編號，作者介紹了一種高效的查錯技巧：透過合併查詢搭配左方反向聯結，系統便能自動篩選出不在正確原料清單內的異常代碼。此外，作者展示了 Power Query 強大的資料夾監控功能，小明只要指定進貨單存放的資料夾，系統便能自動合併資料夾內所有單據，完全省去手動逐檔匯入的時間。

自動化庫存計算、叫貨警示與一鍵更新

最後，小明運用附加查詢將進貨單與領料紀錄向下堆疊，並使用分組依據計算出各原料的總進貨與領料量，藉由自訂公式算出即時庫存。為了預防原物料短缺，作者示範加入條件資料行，當庫存低於安全存量時自動顯示「需要叫貨」，進而產出給供應商的叫貨清單。當整體流程設定完畢並載入 Excel 後，未來只要有新的單據放入資料夾，小明只需點擊全部重新整理，所有的庫存、報表與樞紐分析圖表便會全自動計算與更新。

================================================

# Power Query 功能簡介

嗨，大家好。今天我們要來聊聊 Excel 中一個非常實用的功能。叫做 Power Query。它可以輕鬆整合不同來源的資料。像是 Excel 檔。文字檔。資料夾和網頁等。並且幫我們進行清理和重組。

最後輸出一份乾淨且方便計算的表格。

整個過程完全自動化。不需要花錢訂閱任何的 AI 服務。好，那假設我們有個故事主角叫做小明。他開了一家手搖飲料店。每天店員會把飲料賣了幾杯記在銷售紀錄表。而如果店員從倉庫拿了什麼原料。也會記在「領料紀錄」的表格。除此之外。供應商每次送貨時。也會用 Email 寄來一份 Excel 的進貨單。只是一個月下來。小明手上累積了一堆格式不一的 Excel 檔。裡頭不時也會出現人工輸入的錯誤。因此小明打算用 Power Query 協助他處理資料。把繁瑣的整理工作變得更加輕鬆。好，於是小明首先打開了「報表」這個檔案。裡面記錄了 6 種不同的原料。和它們的安全存量。而要把這些資料匯入到 Power Query。我們可以點擊「從表格/範圍」。那這個表格本身有包含標題列。所以這個選項要把它勾起來。再按下「確定」。如此就會自動開啟 Power Query 的編輯器。而在左側有一個叫做「查詢」的欄位。你可以把「查詢」想成是一套資料整理的流程。如果我們把 Excel 的表格。比喻成餐廳裡已擺上桌的一道菜。那麼「查詢」就像是上菜前。在廚房處理食材和進行料理的流程。好，那我把這個查詢重新命名為「原料清單」。如果想要離開 Power Query。回到 Excel 的介面。你可以執行「關閉並載入至」。那這邊要特別注意。如果我們選擇了第一個選項。會導致這個清單又被匯回到 Excel。導致試算表內會出現兩個完全相同的表格。所以這邊我們可以改選擇「只建立連線」。代表剛才的查詢就放在 Power Query 裡面就好。不需要拿出來。而之後如果想要再回到 Power Query 的視窗。我們只要對著右側的查詢。雙擊滑鼠左鍵就 OK 囉。

# 匯入活頁簿

好，在目前報表的旁邊。還有一個 Excel 檔叫做「門市記錄」。裡面有三張工作表。分別是每天的銷售資料。各項商品的價目表。以及員工從倉庫領取原料的記錄。而要把這些資料匯入到 Power Query。你可以到左上角點擊「取得資料」。「從 Excel 活頁簿」。

接著再去點選「門市記錄」的 Excel 檔。

你可以從左側的清單中。決定要匯入哪一張工作表。而如果想要把它們一次匯入進來的話。你可以啟用「選取多重項目」的選項。那在右下角如果你點擊了「載入」按鈕。會把這三張工作表直接匯入到 Excel。跳過 Power Query 的對話框。但如果你覺得原來工作表中的資料有些雜亂。想要先做些整理。你就必須點擊旁邊的「轉換資料」。如此它們就會被開啟在 Power Query。變成三個新的「查詢」。

# 轉置表格

好，我們先來開啟左側的「價目表」。那目前所有的商品都是採用橫式的排列。這種排法雖然很容易閱讀。但是卻不利於電腦進行資料分析或製作圖表。因此這邊我們要把表格的「列」和「欄」做個對調。那這個指令是位於「轉換」標籤。點擊「轉置」。此時你會發現飲料的名稱全都不見了。這是因為 Power Query 在匯入這張表格時。自作主張把第一行的資料拉到了標題列。而在執行「轉置」的時候。欄位標題並不會跟著一起轉過去。

不過不用擔心。

Power Query 有個特別之處。就是它會把所有操作的步驟記錄下來。列在右側的欄位。因此你可以點擊 X 號還原剛才的轉置步驟。同時你也可以把 Power Query。自動套用的「標頭升階」一併移除。來將飲料名稱保留在第一行的欄位。而此時我們再去執行「轉置」。就能順利地將表格轉成直向。

最後再切換到「常用」標籤。

來把第一行的資料轉換成表格標題就 OK 囉。好，接下來我們來看另一個叫做「銷售記錄」的工作表。乍看之下這整個畫面非常地雜亂。表格的標題目前是位於中間。然後有一行文字錯誤地被判斷成標題。好，所以我們同樣先把 Power Query。自動套用的兩個步驟刪除掉。將錯誤的標題先拉回來。

而這兩行在做表格分析時是派不上用場的。所以我們就啟用「移除資料列」的功能。選擇「移除頂端資料列」。來把表格最上方的兩行直接刪除。

接著再把日期和各種飲料的名稱提升為欄位的標題。

那店員在記錄銷售時。刻意在每週之間保留了一行空白。而這個在做表格分析時也會造成錯誤。對此我們只要執行「移除空白資料列」。就能將所有的空白行一次移除乾淨囉。

# 取消其他資料行的樞紐

好，那你會發現這個表格。其實也是屬於橫式的寬表。並不適合電腦用來做計算與分析。因此這邊我們要把「日期」欄選取起來。切換到「轉換」標籤。來執行「取消其他資料行的樞紐」。代表我們要把「日期」以外的欄位。全部都改成直式的排列。然後你可以替這兩個新欄位進行重新命名。以方便辨識它們的用途。

# 認識資料類型與錯誤處理

好，你會注意到在每個欄位的左側都有一個小圖示。

這個圖示代表的是該欄位的「資料類型」。例如月曆代表的是「日期」。顯示 ABC 的是代表「文字」。而如果顯示 ABC123 則是代表「任何」。即 Power Query 無法判斷它到底是文字或數字。

那杯數一般來說是可以用來計算的「數字」。所以這邊我就選擇「整數」。

只是你會發現此時欄位左側跑出一個小紅點。如果想要知道它的意思。你可以勾選「資料行品質」。就能得知「綠色」是代表正常的數值。而「紅色」代表不正常或錯誤。於是我把畫面捲下來。果然看到有一個格子顯示著 Error (錯誤)。而為了找出背後的原因。這裡我把它的資料類型由「整數」改回「任何」。才發現原來那一天剛好因為鮮奶缺貨。所以員工輸入了一條橫線。表示當天沒有賣鮮奶茶。那要解決這個問題非常地簡單。我們可以使用 Power Query 的「取代」功能。把所有的橫線取代為 0。再按下「確定」。而這時我們再去把這一欄的資料類型改成「整數」時。就不會再顯示任何的錯誤囉。

# 從範例建立新欄位

好，假設今天小明還想要知道這些日期。對應的是星期幾。以方便分析一週之中。

哪一天的生意比較好。那麼此時我們可以使用一個非常方便的功能。叫做「從範例建立資料行」。使用這個功能時。我們只要給它一個例子。Power Query 就會自己推算出規則。例如 2026 年的 1 月 1 號。

那一天剛好是「星期四」。輸入好按下 Enter。Power Query 就能自動推算出。其它日期是星期幾囉。

好，那目前這張表已統計了每天賣出的飲料「杯數」。只要再取得飲料的「價格」。

# 重複與參考查詢

就能計算出每一天的營業額。不過小明想要把目前這張表當成一個範本。不去更改裡面的欄位。因此它對著這個查詢打開右鍵選單。

那這邊有兩個重要的指令。一個是「重複」。「重複」會原地複製出一個相同且完全獨立的查詢表。連同先前的操作步驟也會一起拷貝過來。之後原表格作了任何的修改。也不會影響到新的表格。而另一個指令是「參考」。執行「參考」的話。新表格跟舊表格仍會保持著記錄上的連繫。因此舊表格只要改了任何的東西。新表格也會跟著一起改變。好，那這邊我以「參考」的方式將「銷售記錄」複製一份。並將它命名為「銷售明細」。

# 合併查詢

然後我切換到「常用」標籤。點擊「合併查詢」。透過「合併查詢」。我們就能在目前的表格中。帶入另一個表格的欄位。那這邊我們要去指定合併的對象。其中飲料的價格是位於「價目表」這個查詢。而用來比對的欄位是「飲料名稱」。我們要把它們做個反白。點擊「確定」。

由於「價目表」本身包含了多個欄位。

所以這邊只會顯示 Table (表格)。對此我們需要把它展開。且展開後只需顯示「售價」這個欄位。接著再將底部的選項取消打勾。讓欄位名稱看起來乾淨一些。好，那這時我們發現一個問題。就是「珍珠奶茶」的價格並沒有正確顯示。為了找出背後的原因。

# 修剪多餘空白

我回到「價目表」這個查詢。

點擊「珍珠奶茶」。於是就發現「珍珠奶茶」的後面原來多打了一個空白。導致系統抓不到售價。而要解決這個問題。我們只要切換到「轉換」標籤。在「格式」選單內執行「修剪」。就能立即清除文字前後的多餘空白。修改完成後。當我們再回到「銷售明細」的查詢表。就能看到珍珠奶茶已能正確顯示價格囉。

好，那有了「價格」和「杯數」。我們就可以來計算每件商品當日的營業額。你可以按住 Ctrl 鍵不放同時選取兩個欄位。

並前往「新增資料行」的標籤。來將兩個欄位執行相乘。欄位名稱就取名叫「營業額」。最後我們再將日期欄做個選取來套用遞增排序。於是一張清晰且完整的明細表就大功告成囉。

# 新增自訂公式欄

好，目前這張明細表。不同的商品會分成多行顯示。如果想把這些營業額彙整起來。讓每天只顯示一行的話。我們可以對著「銷售明細」。打開右鍵選單另外建立一個新的查詢。命名為「每日營業額」。那有些欄位不需要顯示在這個表格。因此你可以把它們選取起來之後。

使用右鍵選單將它們直接移除。此外由於這個表格。主要是給小明本人觀看。不需要傳給電腦做進一步的分析。因此我們可以將「飲料名稱」選取起來。執行「樞紐資料行」。來將表格由「直式」轉回原來的「橫式」。

點擊「確定」。最後如果想要把這五件商品的營業額。做個加總的話)。我們可以新增一個自訂的欄位。欄位名稱就叫做「合計」。然後你可以在底下建立一個簡單的公式。來將五件商品的營業額依序做個相加。按下「確定」。如此一來。小明就可以從合計欄。快速掌握當日業績的表現囉。

好，那接下來小明打算繼續來整理領料的記錄。小明發現領料的店員為了省事。每天的日期只寫了一次。而且還把原料的編號和名稱寫在同一格。好在這些問題對於 Power Query 來說都很好解決。

首先日期的空格。

小明只要將每一天執行「向下填滿」。所有的空格就會自動填上正確的日期。然後小明發現「時間」欄跑出了奇怪的 1899 年。而這個只要選取正確的資料格式。就能解決這個問題。再來原料的編號和名稱。如果想要把它們分割成不同的欄位。我們可以選擇「依分隔符號」來分割資料行。並且確認分隔符號已設為「空格」。點擊「確定」。

接著再將這兩個欄位做個重新命名就 OK 了。

而如果反過來。你想要把「日期」和「時間」。合併成一個欄位也沒有問題。因為 Power Query 有提供了一個很方便的指令。

可以將日期和時間合併成一欄。這樣無論是在做排序。或是進行時間的計算都會變得比較方便喔。

# 用左方反向合併找出錯誤值

好，那在整理 Excel 表格時。最棘手的莫過於人工輸入時出了差錯。

影響了資料的正確性。舉例來說。

這邊如果我們往下捲動。會發現有一筆原料的編號應該是 A001。但是員工在輸入時不小心少了一個 0。遇見這種情形。我們要如何用 Power Query 找出這個錯誤值呢？

很簡單。那我同樣用一個新的查詢來做示範。然後切換到「常用」標籤。點擊「合併查詢」。如果想要找出「錯誤」的原料編號。我們勢必就得提供一個編號「正確」的範本。以目前的例子來說。就是「原料清單」這個查詢表。

接著我們再把要用來比較的欄位選取起來。

即原料的編號。至於底下的「聯結」類型。我們要選擇「左方反向」。代表只會列出在「左側表格」中有。但是在「右側表格」中找不到的資料。因此這個功能很適合用來抓錯。

最後按下「確定」。

於是表格內就只會顯示那一筆錯誤的 A01 編號。那既然找到了錯誤的來源。我們就可以回到「領料記錄」的工作表。來把 A01 改成正確的 A001。並且按下 Ctrl +S 進行存檔。而這時我們再回到 Power Query。點擊「重新整理」的按鈕。就會發現檢查錯誤的查詢表已經變成空白了。而之後如果有新的資料進來。我們只需再次點擊「重新整理」。Power Query 就會自動幫我們檢查。是否有員工把原料編號寫錯囉。

# 匯入資料夾到 Power Query

好，Power Query 不光是能匯入單一的 Excel 檔。它也能用來監控電腦的資料夾。舉例來說。每次供應商送貨時。

都會寄來一個 Excel 的進貨單。小明會把它們統一存放在「進貨單」這個資料夾內。如果不想要一個一個去匯入這些檔案。

小明可以到右上角點擊「新來源」。然後選擇「資料夾」。而如果是在 Excel 的介面。

我們也可以從左上角的「取得資料」選單中。找到相同的功能。接著再把「提貨單」這個資料夾打開。

那目前除了 1 月 1 號和 1 月 15 號的進貨單之外。裡面還夾雜了一個其它的檔案。如果想要把它排除掉的話。我們可以點擊「轉換資料」。然後利用篩選的功能。把不需要的檔案取消勾選就 OK 了。

接著我們再去點擊左上角的按鈕。

來把 1 號跟 15 號的進貨單進行合併。工作表就直接選擇「進貨」。點擊「確定」。那 Power Query 為了將整理步驟。套用到資料夾內的每個檔案。它會自動建立一個「協助程式查詢」的資料夾。而在底部我們就能找到剛匯入。且已經合併好的進貨單。有了進貨的數據。

# 附加查詢建立流水帳

小明就可以利用現有的資料。來建立一個簡單的庫存表。簡單來說。就是把「進來」的數量減去「拿走」的數量。於是小明到右上角點擊「附加查詢」。「附加查詢」和「合併查詢」的差別。簡單來說就是一個是「往下堆疊」。

一個是「向右擴張」。那這邊我們已經有了「進來」的進貨單。而「出去」的部分就直接選擇「領料記錄」就 OK 了。點擊「確定」。那有了流水帳之後。我們就可以進一步來計算每個原料的庫存。於是我繼續建立一個新的查詢。命名為「庫存報表」。然後到上方點擊「分組依據」。那這邊我們就把「原料編號」相同的記錄分成一組。

譬如 1 月 1 號跟 15 號都有進貨「鮮奶」。

於是鮮奶的進貨數量就可以把它們做個加總。而如果要計算「拿走」的部分。我們就要切換成「進階」模式。點擊「加入彙總」來把員工領料的記錄也全部加起來。相加的欄位是「領料數量」。點擊「確定」。

那接下來要計算庫存就變得非常簡單了。

我們可以新增一個自訂的欄位。

命名為「庫存」。然後公式就是「進貨數量」減去「領料數量」。按下「確定」。如此一來。小明只要看「庫存」這一欄。就能知道倉庫裡還剩下多少原料囉。

# 新增資料條件欄

好，那小明想要把這個查詢表變得更聰明一點。

譬如原料的庫存量只要低於「安全存量」時。就會自動提醒小明去叫貨。而「安全存量」的數據。小明是把它寫在「原料清單」的表格。於是小明使用「合併查詢」的功能。

從底部載入「原料清單」的查詢表。那合併時比對的依據是「原料編號」這個欄位。點擊「確定」。然後我們再把裡面的欄位展開。只保留「原料名稱」和「安全存量」這兩個欄位就 OK 了。按下「確定」。

最後再把「原料名稱」的欄位移到「編號」旁邊。

好，那這時我們可以來做一個簡單的邏輯判斷。使用「條件資料行」這項功能。欄位名稱我設為「叫貨提醒」。然後將條件設定為。如果「庫存」小於「安全存量」。就顯示「需要叫貨」。否則就輸出「足夠」兩個字。設定完成後按下「確定」。如此小明就能得知「珍珠」和「鮮奶」都已經低於安全存量。需要叫貨囉。

好，小明想要把叫貨的清單直接傳給供應商。只是這個清單不需要像這個表格。顯示這麼多的資訊。於是小明另外建立了一個新的查詢。命名為「叫貨清單」。並且使用篩選的功能。讓表格只顯示需要叫貨的原料。

接著再按住 Ctrl 鍵不放。

把想要保留的欄位依序選取起來。

使用右鍵選單移除掉不要的欄位。這樣就完成了要傳給供應商的叫貨清單囉。

# 載入至 Excel 與樞紐分析表

好，做到這邊。所有的查詢表都已經建置完畢了。而接著小明準備要把需要用到的查詢表載入到 Excel。選擇「關閉並載入至」。勾選「只建立連線」。按下「確定」。那此時所有的查詢表都會列在右側的欄位之中。如果要把某個查詢表載入到 Excel。你可以對著它打開右鍵選單。執行「載入至」。

接著選擇「表格」。

載入的位置就放在新工作表。點擊「確定」。這樣我們就成功載入了每日的營業額。

那你可以重複這個步驟。繼續載入其它的查詢表。有需要的話。你還可以把某個查詢載入為「樞紐分析表」。

譬如我把已賣出的「杯數」放到「值」的欄位。

「飲料名稱」放到「欄」。

最後再把「星期」拖曳到「列」。如此小明就能一眼看出。

他的飲料店星期幾的生意最好囉。

# 重新整理更新資料

好，Power Query 最厲害的地方。在於它能夠把所有我們的操作步驟都記錄了下來。因此到了 2 月。當供應商寄來了新的進貨單時。小明只需把它拖曳到進貨單資料夾內。回到 Excel 切換到「資料」標籤。點擊「全部重新整理」。如此原本缺貨的「珍珠」和「鮮奶」就自動消失了。而且庫存報表內。所有的叫貨提醒也都變成「足夠」囉。

OK，那今天關於 Power Query 的介紹。我們就聊到這邊。我們下回再見。拜拜。

=============

item.description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3nuFa5yEvvQ

值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解 Excel 內建且完全免費的 Power Query 工具，無需訂閱額外 AI 服務即可實現資料自動化清理。
  • 學習實用的資料整理技巧，包括取消樞紐、處理空白值與格式錯誤、資料合併以及利用反向聯結精準抓出人為輸入疏失。
  • 掌握自動監控資料夾多個檔案與一鍵重新整理的技巧，輕鬆打造包含銷售分析與低庫存警示的自動化營運報表系統。

摘要

Power Query 概念與基本資料轉換

作者以經營手搖飲料店的主角「小明」為例，介紹如何運用 Excel 中的 Power Query 整合不同來源且格式混亂的資料。作者指出，Power Query 就像廚房處理食材的自動化流程，能匯入 Excel、資料夾等多種來源並記錄所有清洗步驟。小明將「門市記錄」等表格匯入後，先將原本不易供電腦運算分析的橫向寬表透過取消其他資料行的樞紐轉為直向表格，並迅速移除多餘的標題列與空白行，讓雜亂的銷售資料變得整潔標準。

資料類型校正與銷售明細計算

在清理銷售數據的過程中，作者展示了如何利用資料行品質檢測出文字輸入錯誤，並以取代功能將代表缺貨的橫線修正為數字 0 以免運算報錯。接著，作者示範利用從範例建立資料行推算出星期，並以「參考」方式複製查詢，透過合併查詢功能帶入價目表中的商品售價。針對因字尾多餘空白導致抓不到價格的問題，小明利用修剪功能快速修復，順利計算出每項商品的營業額，最後再透過樞紐資料行重組出便於主管閱覽的每日營業額合計報表。

人工輸入防呆查錯與資料夾批次整合

針對店員記錄領料時的疏忽，小明利用向下填滿補齊日期，並藉由分隔符號分割原料名稱與編號。面對人為鍵入錯誤的原料編號，作者介紹了一種高效的查錯技巧：透過合併查詢搭配左方反向聯結，系統便能自動篩選出不在正確原料清單內的異常代碼。此外，作者展示了 Power Query 強大的資料夾監控功能，小明只要指定進貨單存放的資料夾，系統便能自動合併資料夾內所有單據，完全省去手動逐檔匯入的時間。

自動化庫存計算、叫貨警示與一鍵更新

最後，小明運用附加查詢將進貨單與領料紀錄向下堆疊，並使用分組依據計算出各原料的總進貨與領料量，藉由自訂公式算出即時庫存。為了預防原物料短缺，作者示範加入條件資料行，當庫存低於安全存量時自動顯示「需要叫貨」，進而產出給供應商的叫貨清單。當整體流程設定完畢並載入 Excel 後，未來只要有新的單據放入資料夾，小明只需點擊全部重新整理，所有的庫存、報表與樞紐分析圖表便會全自動計算與更新。
